1.web: I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
1.asv: I will give thanks unto Jehovah with my whole heart; I will show forth all thy marvellous works.

2.web: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
2.asv: I will be glad and exult in thee; I will sing praise to thy name, O thou Most High.

3.web: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.
3.asv: When mine enemies turn back, They stumble and perish at thy presence.

4.web: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.
4.asv: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; Thou sittest in the throne judging righteously.

5.web: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
5.asv: Thou hast rebuked the nations, thou hast destroyed the wicked; Thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.

6.web: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.
6.asv: The enemy are come to an end, they are desolate for ever; And the cities which thou hast overthrown, The very remembrance of them is perished.

7.web: But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.
7.asv: But Jehovah sitteth as king for ever: He hath prepared his throne for judgment;

8.web: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
8.asv: And he will judge the world in righteousness, He will minister judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

9.web: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.
9.asv: Jehovah also will be a high tower for the oppressed, A high tower in times of trouble;

10.web: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.
10.asv: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee; For thou, Jehovah, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

11.web: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.
11.asv: Sing praises to Jehovah, who dwelleth in Zion: Declare among the people his doings.

12.web: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
12.asv: For he that maketh inquisition for blood remembereth them; He forgetteth not the cry of the poor.

13.web: Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death;
13.asv: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah; Behold my affliction which I suffer of them that hate me, Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death;

14.web: that I may show all of your praise. In the gates of the daughter of Zion, I will rejoice in your salvation.
14.asv: That I may show forth all thy praise. In the gates of the daughter of Zion I will rejoice in thy salvation.

15.web: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.
15.asv: The nations are sunk down in the pit that they made: In the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

16.web: Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.
16.asv: Jehovah hath made himself known, he hath executed judgment: The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. [Higgaion. Selah

17.web: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.
17.asv: The wicked shall be turned back unto Sheol, Even all the nations that forget God.

18.web: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.
18.asv: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten, Nor the expectation of the poor perish for ever.

19.web: Arise, Yahweh! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.
19.asv: Arise, O Jehovah; let not man prevail: Let the nations be judged in thy sight.

20.web: Put them in fear, Yahweh. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.
20.asv: Put them in fear, O Jehovah: Let the nations know themselves to be but men. [Selah
